test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Copycat

options.text: One who copies all drawings of cats
One who doesn’t like cats as pets
One who loves cats and dogs

solution:
The correct answer is **'One who imitates another closely'**
